profile.reading: Per QTS own site, RIC3 DC5 is located at 3543 Portugee Road, Sandston, VA 23150 on the QTS Richmond 3 campus, a 221 acre master-planned campus with 240 MW planned upon completion across five Freedom Design buildings (DC1-DC5). Individual building square footage and phased MW capacity are not published.

profile.regional_context: QTS was founded in 2003 by Chad Williams, went public via IPO in 2013, and was acquired by Blackstone (via Blackstone Infrastructure Partners and BREIT) for approximately $10 billion, completed August 31, 2021, at $78/share. QTS is headquartered in Overland Park, Kansas.
profile.facility_type_note: Part of QTS's Richmond, Virginia mega-campus, spanning Henrico County and Sandston. This is QTS's flagship facility story: in 2010 QTS converted a former semiconductor manufacturing site into what Wikipedia describes as a 1.3 million square foot mega data center.

reading.body:
Per-building power capacity for RIC3 DC5 remains unpublished, though the full QTS Richmond 3 campus is planned for 240 MW across five facilities.

RIC3 DC5 is one unit in a master-planned 221-acre campus where QTS converted a former semiconductor manufacturing site. The campus-level capacity target of 240 MW represents the power infrastructure constraint that governs what compute can ultimately be deployed across all five Freedom Design buildings. Individual building allocations have not been disclosed, making it impossible to determine whether power, real estate, or buildout sequencing is the binding constraint at this specific facility.

The data covers campus strategy and total planned capacity but not current operational status, current power draw, or phasing details that would reveal whether RIC3 DC5 is fully built, partially occupied, or still under construction. It also does not include information about power supply reliability, grid connection capability, or cooling infrastructure on the 221-acre site. Without per-building MW figures, the reading cannot assess whether this particular data center is power-limited or grid-limited relative to its shell.
